'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war ]]
**[[Battle of Khartoum (2023–2025)|Battle of Khartoum]]
***[[RSF occupation of the Khartoum International Airport]]
****The [[Sudanese Armed Forces]] retakes [[Khartoum International Airport]] from the [[Rapid Support Forces]] (RSF) and seizes state institutions in [[Khartoum]] captured earlier in the war by the RSF. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2025/03/26/sudanese-army-surrounds-khartoum-airport-and-nearby-areas-military-sources- (Al Arabiya)]
****Sudanese military leader and [[Transitional Sovereignty Council]] Chairman [[Abdel Fattah al-Burhan]] declares the liberation of [[Khartoum]] from RSF forces after two years of fighting. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20250326-sudan-army-retakes-khartoum-airport-from-paramilitaries (France 24)]
*[[War against the Islamic State]]
**[[Islamic State insurgency in Puntland]]
***[[Puntland counter-terrorism operations]]
****The [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. military]] [[American military intervention in Somalia (2007–present)|conducts]] airstrikes targeting [[Islamic State – Somalia Province|ISIS]] militants in the [[Golis Mountains]] as part of a coordinated operation led by [[AFRICOM]]. The strikes reportedly kill militants without causing any civilian casualties in militant hideouts located in the Golis Mountains of [[Puntland|Puntland's]] [[Bari Region]]. [https://24newshd.tv/27-Mar-2025/us-conducts-strikes-against-is-in-somalia (AFP via 24NEWSHD)] [https://www.africom.mil/pressrelease/35764/us-forces-conduct-strike-targeting-isis-somalia (AFRICOM)]
*[[Colombian conflict]]
**A [[Car bomb|motocycle bomb]] explosion near a police station in [[Piendamó, Cauca|Piendamó]], [[Cauca Department]], [[Colombia]], injures 19 civilians. [https://es-us.noticias.yahoo.com/explosi%C3%B3n-atribuida-disidencias-farc-deja-034442633.html (Yahoo News)]
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**Two off duty police officers were killed and another was kidnapped after they were ambushed while traveling on Federal Highway 180D, Cardel-[[Nautla]], in the municipality of [[Vega de Alatorre]].
